Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If Magdelena is an Anarch, and plays Diversion at [tha] for the
maneuver, and then she doesn't get the opportunity to use the
strike part of it, does she still burn the blood?

I think 'no', but just double checking.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


She does. Diversion at [tha] is a strike that requires Thaumaturgy,
and she uses it (to maneuver), so she burns an additonal blood.
